khasi: Kumno phi kyrteng?
Ka kyrteng jong nga dei u John.
Nga sngewbha shibun ban don hangne.
english: I am very pleased to be here.

khasi: Kiei ki jingthmu jong phi?
Ka jingsuk ha kaba kut!
Hangno ka lynti ban leit sha Iewduh?
english: Where is the way to go to Iewduh market?

khasi: Katno kane ka dor?
Nga hap ban leit sha ka painkhana.
english: I have to go to the toilet.

khasi: Wat sngewbha, sngewbha ai bor ïa nga.
Phi lah ban kren phareng?
Nga tip khamtiem ïa ka Khasi.
english: I only know a little Khasi.

khasi: Sngewbha kren suki.
Nga thngan shibun.
Ai um dih sngewbha.
Ka sngi ka shat bha mynta.
english: The sun is shining brightly today.

khasi: U slap u la sdang ban ther jur.
english: The rain has started pouring heavily.

khasi: Nga kwah ban thied kine ki jain.
english: I want to buy these clothes.

khasi: Kano ka kot pule kaba phi pule?
Ki khynnah skul ki leit sha skul man ka step.
english: The school children go to school every morning.

khasi: U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi.
